S.FORM: nyan ki'an roq na Taywan qaniy qa llaqi tayal ga, garing cqa cka rgyax na Sgaga ki rgyax na quri Hagay, qabax llaqi na tayal ga nyan mqasux maki cqa llyung Mnibu ki llyung Klesan, garing bawiqna rgyax ru tehuk cqa syax na bcilung, qabax roq qaniy ga, giwan pinhkngyan na binheci ta cyunga.Llyung na Mnibu ga giway rrgyax, mkura te biyaqan wagi ga qenah bawiq qa rgyax nya, pisan nqargyax Zirhiy ki rgyax Bayu, tyugan seng meta kinbawiq nya. Puqing kinhulan llyung Mnibu qaniy ga, minkahul cqa gong Sgalup, gong Ggiyu, gong Memutang, gong Bubul qalang na Pyanan,cka na llyung Mnibu ga maki gong na Roba, gong Banun, gong Sesuy ru gong Soko. Roq na llyung Mnibu qaniy ga, giway mttasiq rgyax nya, blaq qa cinbwanan nya, mtasaw qa qsyanya, uka ciyan sinnqwaq nya, s'unan qwas na qbhniq pungan, uka pincpngan kinbleqan salan mcisan ru mangay qabax ccquliq. pisan nqa ryaniq na Qpa, pitung bcilung qalang na Talah, gong na Tamaron, ryaniq qalang na Siyanuh, ocya qalang na Tamaron, ulay qsya qalang na Bonbon, ali hbkiyan qalang Banun, qqhuniq na Tayhezang, pitung rgyax na Hmuqan, qmayah tbihi na Qnoran, san mcisan bcilung na Khuyan, gong na Skikun, qmayah tbihi roq na Mnoyan, gong na Bubul ru rgyax qali qalang Pyanan, babaw quri Sqabu ru llyung na Kulu. Bnrwan qa galan cpung ,Biru skrawan tqbaqan ke na cquliq Tayal
S.PHON: njan kiʔan roq na tajwan qanij qa llaqi tajal ɣa ɣariŋ [ʦ|ʨ]qa [ʦ|ʨ]ka rɣjax na [s|ɕ]ɣaɣa ki rɣjax na quri ħaɣaj qaβax llaqi na tajal ɣa njan mqa[s|ɕ]ux maki [ʦ|ʨ]qa lljuŋ mniβu ki lljuŋ kle[s|ɕ]an ɣariŋ βawiqna rɣjax ru teħuk [ʦ|ʨ]qa [s|ɕ]jax na β[ʦ|ʨ]iluŋ qaβax roq qanij ɣa ɣiwan pinħkŋjan na βinħe[ʦ|ʨ]i ta [ʦ|ʨ]juŋalljuŋ na mniβu ɣa ɣiwaj rrɣjax mkura te βijaqan waɣi ɣa qenaħ βawiq qa rɣjax nja pi[s|ɕ]an nqarɣjax zirħij ki rɣjax βaju tjuɣan [s|ɕ]eŋ meta kinβawiq nja puqiŋ kinħulan lljuŋ mniβu qanij ɣa minkaħul [ʦ|ʨ]qa ɣoŋ [s|ɕ]ɣalup ɣoŋ ɣɣiju ɣoŋ memutaŋ ɣoŋ βuβul qalaŋ na pjanan[ʦ|ʨ]ka na lljuŋ mniβu ɣa maki ɣoŋ na roβa ɣoŋ βanun ɣoŋ [s|ɕ]e[s|ɕ]uj ru ɣoŋ [s|ɕ]oko roq na lljuŋ mniβu qanij ɣa ɣiwaj mtta[s|ɕ]iq rɣjax nja βlaq qa [ʦ|ʨ]inβwanan nja mta[s|ɕ]aw qa q[s|ɕ]janja uka [ʦ|ʨ]ijan [s|ɕ]innqwaq nja [s|ɕ]ʔunan qwa[s|ɕ] na qβħniq puŋan uka pin[ʦ|ʨ]pŋan kinβleqan [s|ɕ]alan m[ʦ|ʨ]i[s|ɕ]an ru maŋaj qaβax [ʦ|ʨ][ʦ|ʨ]quliq pi[s|ɕ]an nqa rjaniq na qpa pituŋ β[ʦ|ʨ]iluŋ qalaŋ na talaħ ɣoŋ na tamaron rjaniq qalaŋ na [s|ɕ]ijanuħ o[ʦ|ʨ]ja qalaŋ na tamaron ulaj q[s|ɕ]ja qalaŋ na βonβon ali ħβkijan qalaŋ βanun qqħuniq na tajħezaŋ pituŋ rɣjax na ħmuqan qmajaħ tβiħi na qnoran [s|ɕ]an m[ʦ|ʨ]i[s|ɕ]an β[ʦ|ʨ]iluŋ na kħujan ɣoŋ na [s|ɕ]kikun qmajaħ tβiħi roq na mnojan ɣoŋ na βuβul ru rɣjax qali qalaŋ pjanan βaβaw quri [s|ɕ]qaβu ru lljuŋ na kulu βnrwan qa ɣalan [ʦ|ʨ]puŋ βiru [s|ɕ]krawan tqβaqan ke na [ʦ|ʨ]quliq tajal
